about: Every Mod Swapper release, newest first: the first one is the latest. Paths are relative to this folder. The installer (webapp/installer) reads this.

releases.notes: MIDI: the Teensy's USB is a MIDI port (in and out) and the FM-1's MIDI jack is MIDI in. Jam Box sends MIDI clock. Cleaner menu: names only, long names scroll.
The menu shows every firmware on the card (up to 160, was 16).
First release: Felucca, BBL Jam Box, JIANT FM, Sloop and X0X.
